title: POV: You Wake Up in Mohenjo-daro — An Indus City of Brick and Water #shorts
hook_text: THIS ANCIENT CITY HAD REMARKABLE URBAN INFRASTRUCTURE
description:
Step into Mohenjo-daro, reconstructed as a cinematic historical short using archaeological evidence and cautious interpretation. Some details remain debated or uncertain.

#history #archaeology #lostworlds #ancienthistory #shorts
image_style: cinematic archaeological documentary film still, photorealistic, historically plausible reconstruction, natural skin texture, authentic materials and tools, atmospheric natural light, 35mm lens, realistic scale, no modern objects, no fantasy, no text, no logo, no watermark

scenes.text: You walk into Mohenjo-daro more than four thousand years ago.
scenes.image: Indus civilization city, baked brick streets, people, realistic Bronze Age South Asia

scenes.text: Straight streets run between dense brick buildings in carefully organized neighborhoods.
scenes.image: street-level Mohenjo-daro reconstruction, brick houses and lanes

scenes.text: Wells and covered drains show how water and wastewater were managed across the settlement.
scenes.image: ancient well and covered drainage system in use, documentary realism

scenes.text: Craft workers produce beads, pottery, metal objects, and standardized weights.
scenes.image: Indus artisans making carnelian beads, pottery, bronze and weights

scenes.text: Merchants connect the city to wider trade networks, but its undeciphered script keeps many details uncertain.
scenes.image: merchant goods and Indus seals, no invented readable text

scenes.text: Large public structures include the famous Great Bath, whose exact function remains debated.
scenes.image: Great Bath in active but cautious reconstruction, people nearby, no invented ritual certainty

scenes.text: The city changes and declines over time as wider Indus urban systems transform.
scenes.image: later Mohenjo-daro with quieter streets, environmental change, no invasion trope

scenes.text: Archaeology reveals sophisticated planning while leaving major questions about politics and language unanswered.
scenes.image: excavated brick city and artifacts, archaeological documentary

scenes.text: Its streets are familiar, but its written voices remain unread. What would you ask its people?
